'''Crescent Canyon Overlook''' was a ridge located at the northern edge of the [[Icefall Plains/Legends|Icefall Plains]] of the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Hoth/Legends|Hoth]], just west of [[Dorn Base]]. Though named for [[Crescent Canyon]], it actually overlooked the [[Jagged Plains]] and the [[Buried Field]] of the [[Clabburn Tundra]], with Crescent Canyon located on the northern side of the tundra.
